name: Laurence Farreng - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a new vision for the European Universities alliances
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on the European Universities alliances, groups of universities in different countries that share courses and let students move between them. It says the alliances work well and should get long-term, predictable funding instead of short project grants. It asks for a common European degree label, more research work inside the alliances, simpler rules, and money from national budgets too. It also calls on Hungary to fix rule-of-law problems so its universities can rejoin the Erasmus+ programme.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its position and asks the European Commission and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** Universities and students in the 65 alliances, plus national governments that fund them.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission, which decide whether to follow it.
